sportsFeeds.Notes: AJ Dybansta and Adash Stanley both didnt play in the Oaks final preseason game and could only watch the Oaks lose their 4th straight and finishing the preseaon 0-4. Coach Shepard assured that both AJ and Adash were precautionary measures and would be ready for opening night in cycle 108. Shepard stated that he was hopeful to get the franchise as well as his own first W in preseason but reminded everyone of the work Paulson and Abraham had put into the team and the veteran presence in the regular season is the true proving ground. Shepard was confident in stating he felt the team would have its growing pains but would perform well as an expansion team in year 1.
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: The Oaks end the preseason 0-4 but are optimistic for the season ahead

sportsFeeds.Notes: Adash Stanley was a guest this cycle at Vinnie Keane Firehouse 29 West Oakland Baseball Academy. Adash was there to work on some dribbling drills and his go to work outs. Vinnie emphasized to the youth camp that playing multiple sports allows you to strenghten different muscle groups. The camp was most enthusied with the free throw competition and home run derby between Keane and Stanley. The camp was a massive success with the youth and the comraderie between 2 local athletes is what makes the city great

sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Martin Richards (3B), Peter Busch (OF), Jose Baez (SP), Thomas Gasper (LF), Buford Park (3B), Bryan Franco (SS), Leo Lamar (RP), Cy Newell (SP), Agustin Rodriguez (SS)
sportsFeeds.Notes: Now that the season has come to close we like to take a look back at the players traded this past season and how their seasons played out and who won the trade. Starting with the most controversial is Martin Richards whom was traded at the deadline for a (SS) prospect who days later broke his foot which ended his season. Richards on the other hand , finished with his 2nd best season of his carrer. At age 30 , Richards still has good years remaining for the Mets. Mets won the trade as of now. The second most controversial was trading playoff hero Peter Busch. Busch was shipped to Cleveland with young arm Jose Baez for a top 20 2B prospect Liam Wade. Also, you can see this as A's choosing Vladamir Gonzalez over Busch. In that framing the trade looks a little better on paper but lets not sugar coat this, Peter Busch is a star. Finishing in top 10 in MVP voting shouldnt sit well with A's fans and the thought of Danny Horn and Peter Busch in the same lineup is tough to get over.  Vladamir is not to be overlooked, however, as he put his best stats of his career up, so the choice had nuiance. Jose Baez struggles mightly and was removed from the starting rotation. Cy Newell and Agustin Rodriguez going to Washington for Travis Coles doesnt need much analysis, Travis Coles is the best pitcher in the MLB. Washington didnt draw a dud however as Cy Newell proved to be a top of the rotation starter, and Agustin Rodriguez started slow but finished strong and is a legit everyday SS with allstar potential. Thomas Gasper didnt show too well so far with the Sox, Buford Park proved to be a consisten everyday 3B for the Yankees and shows a ton of potential, Leo Lamar struggled with the Yankees and Bryan Franco never logged a MLB inning with the Yankees after flashy power in his brief time with the A's. Ultimately A's fared very well in winning the most games in MLB history, Losing Richards and Busch is tough but the moves were of necessity rather than misguided.
